// Known-bad Go source, held as data so it is never compiled and never swept.
//
// guard_safety_test.go runs both of its detectors against this file and
// requires both to fire. Without it the harness is two negative assertions over
// a package that currently contains one doc comment — it would pass just as
// happily if the detectors were blind. This is the per-subject anti-vacuity the
// architecture guards use everywhere else (Constitution Law 14.2).
//
// The .txt suffix keeps it out of the build and out of goFilesUnder.

package sample

import "context"

const q = "SELECT id, email FROM app_user WHERE status = $1"

func other() string {
	return `INSERT INTO admin_audit_event (chain_id, seq) VALUES ($1, $2)`
}

type worker struct{}

func (w *worker) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	<-ctx.Done()
	return nil
}
